categories.main_business_segments: Amkor is one of the world's leading providers of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services. The company offers Advanced Products (flip chip, wafer-level processing, and related test services) accounting for 77.4% of 2023 net sales, and Mainstream Products (wirebond packaging, power device packaging, and related test services) accounting for 22.6% of net sales. The company also provides advanced System-in-Package (SiP) modules combining multiple semiconductor and electronic components, which generated $2,955 million in 2023 net sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Amkor specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging technologies including flip chip interconnect, wafer-level chip scale packages (CSP), wafer-level fan-out (WLFO), Silicon Wafer Integrated Fan-out Technology (SWIFT), High Density Fan-Out (HDFO), and redistribution layer (RDL) solutions. The company also develops Through Silicon Via (TSV) interconnects, silicon interposers, and power modules using gallium nitride (GaN) and silicon carbide (SiC) based devices. Manufacturing processes include wafer bump, wafer probe, wafer back-grind, package design, packaging, system-level and final test services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Amkor serves integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), fabless semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and contract foundries. End markets include Communications (50% of 2023 sales, primarily smartphones and tablets), Automotive/Industrial (21%, including ADAS, electrification, infotainment), Computing (16%, including data centers, infrastructure, PCs), and Consumer (13%, including AR, gaming, wearables). The company's ten largest customers accounted for 69% of 2023 net sales, with direct sales to Apple Inc. representing 27.7% of net sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: Amkor operates manufacturing and research facilities in eight countries across Asia and Europe: China, Japan, Korea, Malaysia, the Philippines, Portugal, Singapore, and Taiwan. The company is also preparing to begin operations at a new facility in Bac Ninh, Vietnam. Approximately 96% of employees reside in the Asia-Pacific region, 3% in Europe, and 1% in the United States. The company has executive offices in Tempe, Arizona and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Amkor operates in the midstream to downstream portion of the semiconductor supply chain, providing outsourced packaging and test services that occur subsequent to wafer fabrication. The company receives wafers from customers (generally consigned) and performs packaging and test services before final delivery. Amkor does not manufacture wafers or design semiconductors but focuses exclusively on the assembly, packaging, and testing phases of semiconductor production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Amkor's strategic priorities include leveraging leadership in advanced packaging technologies for high-growth markets (5G, automotive, HPC, artificial intelligence), optimizing utilization of existing assets through multi-customer manufacturing lines, and selectively growing through strategic investments including the Vietnam Facility and planned Arizona facility. R&D focuses on developing highly integrated SiP modules, wafer-level and panel-level packages for 2D and 3D systems, automotive applications using advanced packaging, and high power modules with SiC-based devices. The company employed approximately 950 R&D employees and spent $177.5 million on R&D in 2023.
categories.revenue_model: Amkor generates revenue through the provision of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services on a per-unit or per-service basis. Revenue is recognized as services are rendered, typically over two to three weeks, based on customer-specific stand-alone selling prices that reflect the customized nature of services. The company provides turnkey services including wafer bump, wafer probe, wafer back-grind, package design, packaging, system-level and final test, and drop shipment services. Customers are generally billed at completion of each service or upon completion of all services in a combined offering.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Amkor competes with established packaging and test service providers primarily located in Asia, including ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. and JCET Group Co., Ltd., as well as electronics manufacturing service providers such as Universal Scientific Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. The company also competes with the internal packaging and test capabilities of IDM customers and with contract foundries like Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited and Samsung Electronics that offer full turnkey services. Amkor positions itself as an industry leader in advanced packaging technology with competitive strengths in technology leadership, broad service offerings, geographically diversified manufacturing, and long-standing customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Amkor is a large accelerated filer with 2023 net sales of $6,503.1 million, down 8.3% from $7,091.6 million in 2022. Gross margin was 14.5% in 2023 compared to 18.8% in 2022. Operating income margin was 7.2% in 2023 compared to 12.7% in 2022. Net income attributable to Amkor was 5.5% of sales in 2023 compared to 10.8% in 2022. The company had 28,700 employees as of December 31, 2023, and generated $1,270.0 million in operating cash flow in 2023. Capital expenditures were $749.5 million (11.5% of sales) in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Amkor differentiates itself through advanced packaging technology leadership, offering state-of-the-art package formats and technologies such as 2.5D, DSMBGA SiP, WLFO, and SWIFT that enable miniaturization, higher integration, and improved performance. The company provides a broad offering of packaging design, packaging, and test services tailored to application-specific requirements. Amkor's geographically diversified manufacturing base across eight countries provides supply chain flexibility and cost-effective solutions. The company emphasizes long-standing relationships with leading semiconductor companies, production excellence including high quality and reliability, and collaborative development of proprietary process technologies. Additionally, Amkor commits to environmental responsibility through sustainable IC packaging practices and compliance with international standards.
